title: Intracardiac Flow Assessment in Cardiac Amyloidosis
off: Intracardiac Flow Assessment in Cardiac Amyloidosis
summary: The primary objective of this study is to define the intracardiac flow imaging biomarkers in cardiac amyloidosis.

arms.d: Subjects diagnosed with ATTR cardiac amyloidosis will have CMR, TTE, and 6-minute walk
i: Diagnostic Test: Cardiac magnetic resonance image (CMR)

arms.l: Light chain amyloidosis (AL) with cardiac involvement
arms.d: Subjects diagnosed with AL with cardiac involvement will have CMR, TTE, and 6-minute walk
i: Diagnostic Test: Cardiac magnetic resonance image (CMR)

arms.l: Light chain amyloidosis (AL) without cardiac involvement
arms.d: Subjects diagnosed with AL without cardiac involvement will have CMR, TTE, and 6-minute walk
i: Diagnostic Test: Cardiac magnetic resonance image (CMR)

arms.d: Subjects without history of cardiovascular diseases will have CMR, TTE, and 6-minute walk
i: Diagnostic Test: Cardiac magnetic resonance image (CMR)

primary.m: Define the intracardiac flow imaging biomarkers in cardiac amyloidosis (CA)
